goal: Clean up repository clutter, build a non-destructive layered timeline engine that never guesses to plug holes, restore authentic baseline visits, and overhaul the evidence-backed Fix Proposals engine and Review UI

steps.description: Clean up repository: purge redundant one-off scripts in root and scripts/, restore core application modules to git tracking without personal data leaks, and achieve a clean git working tree
Safeguard source data and implement non-destructive layered engine schema and architecture (raw_source_segments, inference_runs, user_decisions) in db.py and enrichment/layered_engine.py
Eliminate heuristic gap-plugging guesses (SYNTHETIC_LIFE, SYNTHETIC_GAP_HEAL, stretched home stays) and restore 100% of authentic baseline visits from Pixel 10 exports and 2024 Takeout
Repair modal physics anomalies, malformed Place IDs, unsynchronized place categories/cities/visit counts, and road-snapped polyline flags across timeline_viewer.db
Rebuild the Fix Proposals engine around verifiable multi-source evidence (Photos EXIF, Reviews, Plazes, Fit, Breadcrumbs, Lyft) and upgrade the Fix Proposals Review Studio UI
Harden audit_strict_dominance.py and ODLH compiler and pass all 4-Tier Web Verification Gates and E2E tests
